title: Authenticated Project Public-Presentation Operation
summary: Allow only the authenticated mapped owner of a canonical Sesh project to explicitly set its public-presentation state to private or public.
authorization: Authenticated Sesh creator must own the project.
The existing project ownership authorizer is invoked with action write.
Same-origin checking is CSRF defense only and does not replace authentication or ownership authorization.
persistence: Project public-presentation persistence remains separate from SeshMusicProject.
First explicit state mutation creates a publication record.
Subsequent mutation updates only where project_id and owner_creator_id match.
Persisted owner identity cannot be reassigned.
rightsBoundary: Public means eligible for anonymous presentation only.
Public state grants no copyright ownership.
Public state grants no master or composition ownership.
Public state grants no music publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, collaborator, revenue, legal, or account authority.
scope: No anonymous project read is introduced.
No public media delivery is introduced.
No migration is authored or executed.
